items.title: 52031_Kenny Clarke oral history interview
items.q: I see the Steward, and I said, "Hey, Hans, how are you?" He said, "Okay." And we hugged and everything.

ctx.x: MR. CLARKE: Diz, you know, he looked at me with that sly look, said, I got you, I knew I'd get you. So then we went to the Savoy Ballroom, with Chano Pozo and all that, and we formed -- I think it was the greatest band Diz ever had. And we made this famous trip to Europe with Chano Pozo and all. But what really happened on this trip, this trip, it made me realize that I didn't belong in the States. Well, what happened, this fellow, a Swedish fellow, who organized the tour, I had known him from 10 years before, in…

going to be really something," you know. So when we get on the ship, I see the Steward, and I said, "Hey, Hans, how are you?" He said, "Okay." And we hugged and everything. I said, "You're up in first class now." He said, "No, I'm still in third." I said, "You mean we're in third class." He said, "Yeah." So I asked Dizzy, I said, "Hey, Diz, man, you better look at your contract." So then all the other musicians began to follow me.
